mapper.select: SELECT al.id, u.username, 0 as fail_count, al.unlock_at as locked_until, al.locked_at as last_attempt_at FROM account_lock al JOIN user u ON al.user_id = u.id WHERE u.username=#{account} AND al.is_active=1 ORDER BY al.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_lock(user_id, locked_at, unlock_at, is_active, created_at, updated_at) SELECT u.id, NOW(), NOW(), 1, NOW(), NOW() FROM user u WHERE u.username=#{account} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE account_lock SET is_active=0 WHERE user_id=(SELECT id FROM user WHERE username=#{account} LIMIT 1)
